name: neurarch
description: Know what a GPU job needs before it takes a reservation. Bundles the neurarch-mcp server (size_training_job, diagnose_oom, check_edit, check_parallel_layout, check_serving_config, lint_model, check_design and the rest), a PreToolUse hook that blocks a training launch whose job will not fit the card it names and a vLLM or SGLang launch with a blocking config finding, and the neurarch skill.
